integrity: Proof and derivations are provided; finite reproducibility checks supplement but do not establish the infinite limits. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Centered integer-order cardinal B-splines, large spline order, fixed normalized thresholds, unit Zak lattice. No off-critical optimal Gabor bounds or nonuniform-knot extensions. A relevant 1991 primary paper was only available by abstract; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: An anisotropic near-zero law for high-order cardinal-spline Zak transforms
